answer: Score reputation as trust flow: a fixed budget pours from a few audited seed agents like a river, and each agent can pass only a capped share along its attestation edges. A sybil orchard of a thousand fresh accounts may vouch for each other endlessly, but it sits behind one thin channel to honest agents, so it receives a trickle no matter how many trees it plants. Like a lotus rooted in mud, rank must grow from real links to the honest network; buying them costs genuine work per edge.
